children: rose 23.33% premarket after reporting fiscal second-quarter revenue of $1.55 billion, up 35% year over year, and product revenue of $1.49 billion, up 37%. Adjusted earnings of $0.62 per share beat the $0.45 LSEG consensus. The GAAP net loss narrowed to $191.7 million from $297.9 million a year earlier. Remaining performance obligations reached $9.00 billion, up 30%, and net revenue retention held at 126%.

CoCo, the coding agent, surpassed 9,100 accounts after adding more than 2,000 in the quarter, while CoWork reached 5,800. Snowflake added 692 net new customers. Non-GAAP operating income reached $237 million. The largest adjustment between that and the GAAP operating loss is $456.4 million in stock-based compensation-related charges, or 29% of revenue. Free cash flow was $83.8 million.

Management raised full-year product revenue guidance to $6.07 billion, up from $5.84 billion, and lifted its non-GAAP operating margin target to 14.5% from 13.5%. Third-quarter product revenue is guided to roughly $1.59 billion against $1.50 billion StreetAccount consensus. CFO Brian Robins called it the "third consecutive quarter of product revenue growth acceleration," delivered alongside margin expansion.

title: Snowflake Stock Jumps 23% as Growth Accelerates a Third Quarter
